title: Privacy and your data
intro: See what Horizon keeps about you, take a copy, or remove it. Changes here happen straight away.
downloadBody: A file with your profile, your banks and every entry, and your transfers. Bank access keys are left out: they are keys, not information about you.
banksBody: Removing a bank deletes its entries from Horizon and cuts Horizon's link to it. Transfers you made stay in the other person's history.
deleteBody: This deletes your login, profile, banks and all their entries. It cannot be undone.
deleteKeeps: What stays: transfers you sent or received remain in the other person's history, with your name and email removed. Our payments partner (Dwolla) is required to keep a closed record of payment customers; we close yours.
deleteUnderstand: I understand this cannot be undone
deletePasswordHint: We ask again so nobody else can delete your account from a computer you left signed in.
errSignIn: You need to be signed in.
errTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errNotYours: That bank is not on your account.
errFailed: That did not work. Nothing else was changed. Please try again.
deleteEmailHint: You sign in with Google, so there is no password to ask for. Type your account's email; if you signed in more than 15 minutes ago, sign out and in again first.
errEmail: That is not this account's email.
errRecentSignIn: For safety, sign out and sign in again, then delete within 15 minutes.
